tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /mgon po stag zhon snubs lugs kyi gtor chog 'phrin las lhun grub bzhugs so/ /bla ma mchog dang gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po la phyag 'tshal lo/
༄༅/ /mgon po stag zhon snubs lugs kyi gtor chog 'phrin las lhun grub bzhugs so/ /bla ma mchog dang gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po la phyag 'tshal lo/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mgon po stag zhon snubs lugs kyi gtor chog 'phrin las lhun grub bzhugs so// bla ma mchog dang gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po bka'i bya ra ba/ pha mes brgyud pa'i srung ma stag zhon 'khor bcas la gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod pas/ dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa 'di nyid kyis/ rjes su gnang ba thob pa rgyun gyi dus sam/ nyer dgu la sogs pa dus gnyan khyad par can la yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su/ mgon po 'di nyid kyi bris sku rab gnas can la sogs pa'i rten gyi drung du/ stegs bu mtho zhing gtsang bar lcags snod la sogs par nas nag rjen btags kyi phye khrag chang gis sbrus pa'i mgon po'i gtor ma ri rab bang rim gsum pa ba gam dang bcas pa'i steng du/ bshos bu gru gsum bzhag de'i g.yon du lha mo'i gtor ma ri rab bang rim gsum pa/ ba gam dang bcas pa'i steng du ting lo bzhag pa/ yab kyi gtor ma yi mdun du thugs kyi mon pa'i gtor ma bshos bu gru bzhi/ g.yas su sku'i mon pa la bshos bu gru bzhi/ g.yon du gsung gi mon pa la bshos bu gru gsum/ rgyab tu dzam+bha la'i zlum gtor/ de bzhi'i g.yas g.yon du chang bu gyen bslang brgyad bzhag pa byang phyogs gnod sbyin brgyad la/ de'i g.yon du mtheb kyu brgyad bzhag pa lho phyogs kyi gshin rje brgyad la/ lha mo'i gtor ma'i phyogs bzhir chang bu gyen bslang bzhi dang mtheb kyu bzhi bzhag pa gling bzhi srid pa'i ma mo brgyad la'o/ /de rnams kyi mthar mtheb kyu bcad kha phyir bstan pas bskor/ bsdus pa byed na yab la dpal bshos zur gsum che ba dang / lha mo la snying gzugs ma gcig bya/ de rnams kyi mtha' skor ram zur du snang srid lha srin sde brgyad la sha brgya zan brgya bsham/ yab yum gyi gtor ma la mda' bya rgod ma la dar nag po dang sngon po'i cod paṇa lcam dral gyi sku tsaka li dang bcas pa gzug

de rnams la grir bsad pa'i sha khrag sgog tsong / tsan dan la du la phug la sogs pas brgyan pa lag len ltar bshams/ gzhan yang dam tshig rdo rje dril bu thod rnga rkang gling hasta'i g.yab dar la sogs pa nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad kun tshogs par byas te/ rnal 'byor pa stan bde ba la 'dug ste yi dam gyi lha khro bo gang yang rung ba'am/ khyad par du gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa gtor ma'i bar du tshang bar byas la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du dur khrod chen po'i sa gzhi 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' bar/ bh+rūm̐ las gnam lcags 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i nang du pad+ma dang nyi ma ro'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las dpal mgon po mahā kā la sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhal rab tu gdangs shing mche ba rnon po bzhi gtsigs nas ljags glog ltar 'khyug cing a la la las ci bgyi zer ba/ dmar zhing bzlog pa'i spyan gsum gdangs mig tu bgrad nas dam nyams pa'i rjes gcod pa/ khro gnyer nag po rab tu bsdus shing smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba/ ral pa kham nag gyen du brdzes shing phyed thur du bstibs pa dang / dug sbrul gyi ral pas stod khebs pa/ phyag g.yas tsan dan gyi ber chen nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phyar bas dgra bgegs kyi klad pa 'gems pa/ beng stod nas lha dmag 'bum dang / beng smad nas bdud dmag nyi khri chig stong 'gyed pa/ phyag g.yon lcags kyi par bu'i nang na dam nyams kyi khrag dron mo 'khol ba'i khrod na snying dmar 'dar zhing gsol ba/ 'jol ber nag po dgu brtsegs gsol zhing gser skegs sked la bcings pa rin po che'i pho long dang 'phyang 'phrul g.yer kha'i drwa ba sil sil gyi sgra sgrog pa/

mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan pa/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa'i mgur chung dang / snyan rgyan dang / do shal byas pa zhabs gnyis la sag ti nag po'i lham 'bob gsol ba/ khyab 'jug rā hū la myur mgyogs kyi stag chen smyon par sprul nas dam nyams kyi bam ro rlon pa 'grad cing rol pa'i steng na chibs pa/ srog bdag rgyal po seng ge rngams par brdzus nas phyi nas 'brang ba/ ye shes kyi me dpung dmar nag 'bar zhing 'khrug pa'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/ dgra bgegs thams cad skad cig nyid la za ba'i rngams stobs can/ srid gsum thams cad 'dar zhing skrag par byed pa'o/ /de'i g.yon du khrag zhag gi rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrug pa'i dbus su/ bh+yo las dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma sku mdog dmar nag srin mo khros pa'i gzugs can zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas bdud kyi khram shing nag po 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod rlon khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin zhing nad kyi rkyal pa mchan khung g.yon du thogs pa/ khrag gi ral pas stong khams khyab pa/ spyi bor rma bya'i sgro'i mdongs kyis brgyan pa/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi'i stod g.yogs dang re lde nag po'i sham thabs can/ dug sbrul ske rags bcings pa/ khrag zhag gis lus byugs shing thod pa skam rlon dang sbrul rus kyis brgyan pa/ lcags kyi drel rta srin po'i thod pa'i ya 'gal la sga'i snga ru dang / ma 'gal la phyi ru mi lpags kyi sga g.yogs pa dang sbrul gyi gong smad byas pa la chibs pa/ snga sha la nad kyi rkyal pa dang phyi sha la mtshon gyi gru gu btags pa/ snang srid kyi ma mo bye bas bskor ba/ mgon po'i g.yas su tri las sku'i sprul pa khram thogs bdud kyi mon pa nag po ber nag gyon pa/ g.yas pa tri shu la'i rtse mo la mi ro dmar po khrag 'dzag pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / g.yon dar nag gi ru tshon 'phyar bas dmag gi sna 'dren cing dgra bo'i sde 'jig par byed pa/

g.yon du yaṃ las gsung gi sprul pa srog gcod btsan gyi mon pa dmar nag bse khrab gyon pa/ g.yas ma he'i rwa dung 'bud pas snang srid lha 'dre'i dmag dpung sdud cing / g.yon pa zhags pa nag pos dgra bo'i ske nas 'ching zhing 'khrid pa/ mdun du dzaḥlas thugs kyi sprul pa bla 'gugs gying gi mon pa sngo nag mi lpags rlon pa'i gos gyon pa/ g.yas lcags kyi spu gris dgra bo'i khog pa gshag cing / g.yon pa tsit+ta dmar po phyungs nas gtso bo'i zhal du stob pa/ rgyab tu hūm̐ las nor bdag dzam+bha la nag po g.yas thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin cing / g.yon ne'u le brla steng du 'dzin pa/ dar dang sbrul gyis brgyan zhing rna ba ma phug pa rigs ngan gyi cha lugs can/ zhabs brkyang bskum gyis nor bdag ser po gan rkyal du mnan pa/ de rnams kyi rgyab phyogs su sha zan gyi mon pa/ khrag 'thung gi mon pa/ snying 'byin gyi mon pa/ bla 'gugs kyi mon pa/ gzer 'debs kyi mon pa/ tshe 'phrog gi mon pa/ srog gcod kyi mon pa ste/ bdud kyi mon pa bdun po thams cad kyang mdog nag po/ g.yas ral gri dang / g.yon thod khrag thogs pa'i bdud dmag 'bum gyis bskor ba/ dgra bo'i srog dbugs la rngam pas da lta nyid du rgyug cing gsod pa la rings pa'i rnam pa can/ mon mo nag mo bdun 'khor bud med nag mos stong khams khengs pa bh+yo dang dza'i sgra sgrog cing / khrag thun gyi zor 'phen cing / lcags mkhar gyi phyi khor yug la gnas nas bka' nyan cing dam nyams sgrol ba'i las byed pa ni/ bdud mgon ri nag spungs pa mdog nag cing mi sdug pa/ ral pa nag po mun ltar gtib pa/ mi lpags rlon pa gyon pa/ khram shing dang zhags pa thogs pa/ rta nag la zhon nas snga sha la bdud kyi khram baṃ dang / phyi sha la mi ro rta ro bkal nas rgyug pa/ lha mgon rgyal po 'od lha dkar po/ dbu rgyal zhu dang / lus la dar dkar gyi ral khu gyon pa/

'khor lo dang shak+ti thogs pa/ rta dkar po phung dmar la zhon pa/ mon pa lcags zhu nag po ral pa dmar nag thur du gtibs shing so tham byed pa/ tri shu la dang thod khrag thogs pa/ me klong gi dbus na bzhugs pa/ btsan mgon shu bo srog len mdog dmar nag dar dmar gyi thod bcings pa/ ber dmar dang bse khrab gyon pa/ mdung dmar khrag gi ba dan tsan dan dang / btsan gyi zhags pa dmar po thogs pa/ rta dmar la zhon pa/ gying mgon rdo rje legs pa mdog ljang ser/ za 'og gi ber gyon zhing thod bcings pa/ rdo rje rtse gsum gyi rtse la bya khra lding ba dang / ra snying dmar po thogs pa/ lcags spyang la zhon pa/ klu mgon nag po dug sbrul gyi gdengs ka dang sbrul mjug can/ sbrul zhags dang sbal pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ ma he sngo nag la chibs pa/ ma mgon rdo rje sder chen nag mo srin mo'i gzugs can khrag gi ral pa 'phyang ba/ mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs re lde'i sham thabs dang / tri shu la dang ba dan dmar po thogs pa/ dug mtsho 'khol ma'i klong mthing gur gyi nang na bzhugs pa/ gza' mgon rā hu la dud kha mgo dgu pa sbrul mjug can/ lus mig gis gang ba/ chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang / rwa'i mda' gzhu thogs pa/ sprin dang rlung 'tshub kyi khrod na gnas pa/ de thams cad kyang rang rang gi 'khor tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ 'jigs shing rngams la drag cing rtsub pas dgra bgegs thams cad skad cig la rdul du rlog pa'o/ /gzhan yang las mkhan sprul pa'i tshogs/ beng chen las sprul pa lha dmag 'bum ni thogs med rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa ste/ phyogs kyi nam mkha' bar snang thams cad khengs pa/ bdud dang srin po'i dmag rnams kyis sa gzhi thams cad rlung ltar 'tshub cing khyab pa/ g.yas kyi ru 'dren lha dmag nyi khri chig stong go cha sra zhing mtshon cha rno bas lha rta ngang pa g.yu rngog zhon pa/ g.yon gyi+i ru 'dren ma mo bye ba'i tshogs khram shing dang nad rkyal thogs nas drel rta la zhon pa/

sprul pa ce spyang mang po 'dur zhing khrag gi dri snom pa/ lho phyogs kyi gshin rje brgyad stag gzig dom dred 'phar ba spyang kir sprul nas sngon gyi sna 'dren pa/ byang phyogs kyi gnod sbyin brgyad lcags kyi bya khrar sprul nas slad kyi rjes su 'brang ba/ de rnams kyi sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyi dmag tshogs dang bcas pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung zhing / rnal 'byor gyi las la brtson pa/ dam nyams kyi sha khrag dang srog dbugs la rngams shing rol ba'o/ /gtso 'khor de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can grangs med pa 'phros pas/ lcang lo can gyi dur khrod/ ri bo ma la ya'i gnas/ dur khrod phung lung nag po/ 'od ma'i tshal gyi dur khrod la sogs pa nas dpal mgon stag zhon nag po bka' nyan 'khor dang bcas pa sngon gyi dam tshig rjes su dran pas lho sprin nag po rlung gis bskyod pa ltar skad cig de nyid la thibs kyis byon par bsams la/ thod rnga dang mi rkang gi gling bu la sogs pa rol mo'i sgra sgrog hasta dar nag gis g.yab/ sha chen gyi spos dud sbyar/ dung pa'i dbyangs sam nga ro drag pos/ rgyud las/ ༈ hūm̐/ rab 'jigs dur khrod chen po lcang lo can/ /ri bo ma la ya yi gnas mchog nas/ /gnam lcags ur mo rab tu ta la la/ /rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong me re re/ /zhing chen keng rus lhu sdum khro lo lo/ /'dab chags sha za mang po lding zhing 'dur/ /gsur chen dud pa'i tshogs ni 'khyil zhing 'tshub/ /de 'dra'i dur khrod rab tu 'jigs pa nas/ /ging chen mgon po yab yum sku bskyod la/ /gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /ging bdud ma mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dam tshig dbang gis spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/

/oṃ shrī ma hā kā la tri yam̐ dzaḥdzaḥtrag rak+sha ha la dzaḥdzaḥdun tu tra ru thum bha ti dzaḥshu la ra tsa tri shaṃ dzaḥyaṃ dzaḥ badz+ra tri rna sa dhu kha thuṃ tri sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ sa pā ri wa ra a gats+tsha ya a gats+tsha ya pra be sha ya pra be sha ya/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ya ban+dha ya/ a wa lo ka ya a wa lo ka ya/ a kar+ṣa ya/ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bdud 'dul sgro+ol ging chen po ste/ /rdo rje 'dul byed drag po rtsal/ /srin po laṅka pu rangs kyi/ /grong khyer chen po brlag mdzad pa/ /lha ma yin gyi bu mo ni/ /glog srin 'dul bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /lha chen mgon po nag po khyod/ /spyan 'dren 'dir bzhugs 'phrin las mdzod/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i spyan snga ru/ /khas blangs dam bcas ma bsnyel bar/ /gru gsum mthing nag dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bzhugs la bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ma hā kā la sa pā ri wa ra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes pas spyan drangs gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis/ ༈ bka' yi bstan pa srung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /bdud 'dul dbang phyug ma hā ka la'i tshogs/ /nag po chen po lcam dral 'khor bcas la/ /dam nyams bsgral ba'i nyer spyod 'bul ba ni/ /myos byed dpa' bo skom du btung ba'i phyir/ /dza gad bdud rtsi rak+ta dmar chen 'bul/ /lha tshogs sku yi dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i phyir/ /dgra bgegs dbang po lnga yi me tog dbul/ /shangs kyi dbang po rab tu tshim byed pa'i/ /gsur chen dud pa'i tshogs rnams mchod par 'bul/ /'khor bcas spyan gyi dbang po tshim byed pa'i/ /zhun chen sgron me 'bar ba'i snang gsal 'bul/ /lha chen thugs kyi dbang po tshim byed pa'i/ /dmar chen mkhris pa'i dri yis byugs pa 'bul/ /rdo rje ljags kyi dbang po mnyes byed pa'i/ /dmar nag bshos bu 'byar ba zhal zas 'bul/ /dpal mgon snyan gyi dbang po tshim byed pa'i/ /sna tshogs rol mo'i sgra dbyangs mchod par 'bul/

/oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pāt+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū+uṣ+pe/ a lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi ti/ shap+ta pra tits+tsha ye swā hā/ ces pas phyi mchod dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum brjod/ stong gsum ma lus 'bru bcud sman dang bcas/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /kha dog dri ro nus pa mchog ldan pa/ /pha bla ma nyid kyis/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du khā raṃ khā hī/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal du༞ gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po'i༞ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas༞ phung byed shan+tiṃ gar+bha'i༞ roṃ bu gu pa tsan+d+ra'i༞ rgya gar khrag 'thung nag po'i༞ slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i༞ bal po ba su dha ra'i༞ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes༞ dge bshes grang nga kun grags༞ swa'i ban+dhe 'bum grags༞ skyo+o'i ban+dhe mthu chen༞ lce btsun mdo sde seng ge༞ mtshungs med rongs pa rga lo'i༞ lce btsun blo ldan seng ge'i༞ bla ma sribs bu chung ba'i༞ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan༞ kun mkhyen chos rgyal dpal bzang༞ dbon chen chos skyong mtshan can༞ drin can pha rgod bla ma'i༞ yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal du khā raṃ khā hī/ ces bla ma brgyud pa dang yi dam la phul nas/ hūm̐ lcang lor bcas pa'i dung chen ban+dha ru/ /byang chub sems dang maṃ sa rak+ta dang / /dri chen ku ku chu ste bdud rtsi lnga/ /gnyis med sbyar ba'i dam rdzas a mṛ ta/ /nag po stag zhon 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /dpal ldan ma hā kā la'i zhal du khā raṃ khā hi/ /ma gcig 'dod khams dbang mo'i༞ sku gsung thugs kyi mon pa'i༞ nor bdag dzam la nag po'i༞ bdud kyi mon pa pho mo'i༞ las byed dregs pa sde brgyad༞ lho phyogs gshin rje brgyad kyi༞ byang phyogs gnod sbyin brgyad kyi༞ dur khrod ma mo bye ba'i༞ lha dmag nyi khri chig stong༞ bdud dang srin po'i dmag tshogs༞ bka' nyan dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi༞

gnas bdag gzhi bdag gnyan po'i zhal du khā raṃ khā hi/ zhes pas mgon po 'khor bcas la dbul/ hūm̐ bdud 'dul dbang phyug nag po 'jigs byed che/ /ma hā kā la rdo rje 'jigs pa'i tshogs/ /khams gsum sgrol ging chen po'i dngos grub ni/ /sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag la dus 'dir stsol/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ka ya sid+dhi oṃ/ wak+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dha hūm̐/ ces rang gi lce thog tu bzhag pas dngos grub blang zhing dam tshig bsre ba'o/ /rak+ta 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ rlung nag 'tshub ma'i klong dkyil nas/ /mon pa nag po brda mi 'phrod/ /mgyogs byed dpa' bo stag la zhon/ /bdud btsan srin po ma mo ging / /klu yi tshogs dang bcas pa yi/ /nag po chen po 'khor bcas la/ /dam rdzas rak+ta dmar chen 'bul/ /bdag gi dgra bgegs myur du sgrol/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ye sa pā ri wā ra ma hā maṃ sa ma hā tsit+ta ma hā kem ni ri ti kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes brjod/ de nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas la/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje nus pa mthu stobs spyan drangs/ chos skyong gi spyi bor thim pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rnam par gyur te rgyas btab/ de las rdo rje phra mo dpag med 'phros pas sku thams cad rdo rje phra mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i go khrab can sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mthu stobs nus pa 'phrin las kyi ngo bor gyur par bsam/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pā ri wā ra sa ma ye s+pha ra ye sa ma ye ma thi kra ma ye sa ma ye rak+ṣan+tu/ kye rnal 'byor kun gyi dpal mgon mchog /ma hā kā la mthu rtsal can/ /stag la zhon pa'i nag po che/ /chos skyong mgon po khyod gson cig /bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo 'di/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi sku dgra yin/ /sngags 'chang bdag la rgyas btsugs so/ /srung ma khyed la do bsdos so/

/lo dang zla bar ma bzhag par/ /zhag dang za ma kho nar sgrol/ /da lta nyid du rtags phyung zhig /ma hā kā la'i rten 'cha'o/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di 'bul lo/ /rgyun gyi gtor mas thugs dam skong / /grub pa'i rtags dang mtshan ma myur du phyung cig /bdag gis khyod la rdo rje gsang ba'i dbang bskur gyi/ gnas dang 'khor dang longs spyod thams cad srungs shig /skyongs shig spel cig rgyas par mdzod cig dgra rkun la sogs pa mi mthun par lta ba thams cad la ltas ngan pa dang stab snol sna tshogs thongs la tshar gcod/ dgra dpung sgrol/ bdud dpung bshig bgegs dpung choms/ khams gsum dbang du bsdus/ srid gsum zil gyis gnon/ bstan pa bsrung ba'i las mtha' dag grub par mdzod cig ces dam la bzhag cing srung mar bsgo'o/ /gtor ma a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las e las 'brub khung gru gsum pa'i nang du/ ṇi tri las dgra bgegs kyi gzugs brnyan nyam thag pa'i rnam pa can du bsam/ ṇi dzaḥtri dzaḥ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭa/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa 'phros pas mgon po 'khor bcas kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ bdag mdun las spros pa'i khro bo lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog mtshon cha thogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ snang srid kyi bsgral ba'i zhing thams cad dang / khyad par sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa/ bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba/ rnal 'byor gyi sgos dgra byed pa thams cad lcags kyus snying nas zungs/ /zhags pas ske nas chings/ rnga mong 'jigs su rung ba gcig gi steng du bkyon nas/ las kyi rlung nag 'tshub mas yud kyis khyer/ pho nya mtshon cha thogs pas rgyab nas ded cing rgyobs gsod la sogs pa'i sgra sgrogs bzhin pas rang dbang med par skad cig nyid la 'brub khung du bskyur nas gzugs brnyan dang gnyis su med par gyur/

gri gug gis khog pa gshags te/ de'i tshe srog drod rnam shes/ go cha srung ba rnams oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi rnam par thon nas rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ pho nya rnams kyis mtshon cha'i char phab nas dum bur btubs te sha khrag rus pa'i phung por gyur pa'i sha la oṃ/ khrag la āḥ rus la hūm̐/ de'i 'od kyis dug gsum sbyangs/ ngo bo zag med kyi bdud rtsi/ rnam pa dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus pa'i phung po stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum brjod/ mgon po 'khor bcas kyi ljags a las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje nag po chen po rtse gsum pa 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis drangs te gsol bar bsams la/ rdo rje gsor zhing / hūm̐ nga ni khro bo'i rgyal po ste/ /lag na rdo rje rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje'i lus la rdo rje 'phro/ /thams cad ma lus zil gyis gnon/ /de yi bka' nyan mthu bo che/ /chos skyong mgon po bstan srung mgon/ /ma hā ka la mthu rtsal can/ /zas su dgra bo'i sha za zhing / /skom du dgra bo'i snying khrag 'thung / /khyod ni sha za khrag 'thung ste/ /bstan pa gnyan po bsrung slad du/ /rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma dang / /dgra bo'i sha khrag mchod par bzhes/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las myur du sgrubs/ /dam nyams dgra bo da lta sgrol/ /dus la babs po sa ma yā/ /oṃ shrī sogs mgon po yab yum mon pa dang bcas pa'i sngags kyi rjes su sa pā ri wā ra sarbā bigh+nan sha truṃ mā ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ zhes rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i mthar se gol gtog bzhin pa lan gsum la sogs pas dbul/ hūm̐ chos skyong dpal ldan mgon po mchog /oṃ ni ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /shrī ni bdag gzhan yongs kyi dpal/ /mgon gyur dpal 'bar chen po nyid/

/ma hā che btsan dpe med de/ /kā la nag po 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /gtum po 'od 'bar drag shul can/ /tri zhes sgrol ging shan pa bskul/ /yaṃ nyid drag po'i rlung gi shugs/ /dzaḥdzaḥdamigs pas 'gugs pa ste/ /gsang ba mchog gi bdag po lags/ /khams gsum mthu chen bdag po lags/ /ma hā kā la khyod la bstod/ /bh+yo/ trag las khrag mtsho 'khol ma'i nang / /rak+sha srin po'i gzugs 'chang ma/ /ha la dug gi gad rgyangs can/ /nam gru nag mo re ma ti/ snying kha rak+mo dgra snying khug /ma mo nag mo las la bh+yo/ /me dang rgyal po chu dang dug /ma rungs gcan gzan la sogs pa/ /gdug pa'i gnod pa kun las skyobs/ /khams gsum dbang du bsdus pa dang / /srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa dang / /tshe dang dbang thang la sogs spel/ /longs spyod rgyas shing dbul ba sel/ /nad dang sdug bsngal rab zhi nas/ /'jig rten mi nub rgyal mtshan du/ /grags pa chen po bla med mdzod/ /ces pas bstod/ de nas sman rag sbrengs la dmod bskul bya ste/ hoḥ dpal ldan mgon po ma hā ka la/ legs ldan nag po/ dkyil 'khor kun gyi srung ma/ bdud 'dul kun gyi dbang phyug dug gsum nad kyi sman pa/ rig 'dzin yongs kyi srog shing / dam pa chos kyi srung ma/ rnal 'byor yongs kyi dgra lha/ gtsug lag kun gyi chos skyong / dam nyams kun gyi gshed ma/ bstan srung kun gyi gtso bo/ lha dmag yongs kyi dpa' bo/ lha min kun gyi g.yul bzlog lha'i ded dpon chen po/ che btsan 'gran zla med pa sku la ber nag po dgu brtsegs gsol te gzi brjid mun ltar gtibs pa/ phyag g.yas tsan dan gyi beng chen bsnams pa las bdud dang srin po'i dmag dpung nyi khri chig stong 'gyed pa/ g.yon pa lcags par nag po bsnams nas dam nyams dgra bo'i snying khrag zhal du gsol ba/ chibs su myur mgyogs kyi dpa' bo stag la chibs pa/ nyi zer dang zla zer dang skar chen gyi 'od bzhin du 'gro ba/

srin po laṅka pu ri'i grong khyer 'joms shing / lha ma yin gyi grong khyer sum brtsegs brlag par byed pa/ gnod sbyin gyi bu mo glog ma srin 'dul bar zhal gyis bzhes pa/ zhal nas drag po'i nga ro sgrog cing dregs pa can las la 'khol ba/ lta ba log pa dang dam nyams pa'i gshed ma mdzad pa/ lho phyogs kyi gshin rje mthar byed brgyad ni stag gzig dom dred spyang kir sprul nas sngon la 'gro zhing / snga dgra dar ba rtsad nas chod cig byang phyogs kyi gnod sbyin chen po brgyad ni lcags kyi bya khra hor pa brgyad du sprul nas phyi nas 'brang zhing phyi dgra sems pa drung nas 'byin pa/ nyi ma byang shar gyi nag mo re ma ti ni/ chibs su dre'u rta rkang gsum la chibs nas khram shing dang nad rkyal thogs pas rlung nag 'tshub ma dang bcas te legs nyes kyi stangs 'dzin cing bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad pa/ skye 'gro'i srog dbugs sdud cing mna' zan dam nyams kyi gshed ma mdzad pa/ khram thogs bdud kyi mon pa/ srog gcod btsan gyi mon pa/ bla 'gugs ging gi mon pa ste sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa'i mon pa gsum srog gcod bdud kyi mon pa nag po bdun dmag 'bum khri'i dpung gis bskor ba/ btsan gyi ma mo nag mo bdun la 'jig rten gyi ma mo bye bas bskor ba/ gzhan yang nag po chen po khyod kyi bka' 'khor na gnas pa'i srog gshed kyi dregs/ bdud mgon nag po spyi ring / srog bdag 'od lha dkar po/ btsan rje shu bo lag ring / mon pa lcags zhu nag po/ klu mgon nag po srog gcod/ gnod sbyin srog gi se brdar/ ma mo rdo rje sder chen/ gza' rgod nag po rā hu la/ lha dmag nyi khri chig stong / bdud dmag nyi khri chig stong / 'jig rten gyi dregs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis dmar chen gyi gtor ma longs/ sman raka gi mchod pa bzhes la/

sngon 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gi spyan sngar khas blangs shing dam bcas pa dang / byang chub kyi shing drung du bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa dang / lcang lo can gyi grong khyer du gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po'i༞ dur khrod phu lung nag por༞ slob dpon shan+tiṃ gar+bha'i༞ bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang du slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi༞ 'od ma'i tshal gyi gnas su gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi༞ mdor na drin can pha rgod bla ma'i zhabs kyi bar du rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang / rnal 'byor pa bdag gis bsten bsten sgrub sgrub gsol gsol mchod mchod pa'i bka' dang dam tshig gnyan pa rjes su dgongs te/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod mi nor longs spyod dgon gnas yul gzhis dang bcas pa dus da nas bzung ste/ sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du khyod la bcol zhing gnyer du gtad pa yin pas lus dang grib ma ltar du 'grogs la bsrung ba dang skyabs pa dang sba bar mdzod cig nyin gsum gyi bya ra mdzod/ mtshan gsum gyi mel tshe mdzod/ 'gal rkyen nad gdon sdug bsngal bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzod/ mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor dbang phyug snyan grags lung rtogs kyi yon tan thos bsam sgom pa'i 'phrin las thams cad dar zhing rgyas par mdzod/ khams gsum dbang du bsdus/ srid gsum zil gyis gnon/ chags che nyam nga byad kha rbod gtong rmi ltas ngan pa/ mtshan ltas ngan pa thams cad phyir la bzlog cing bsgyur/ gnod cing 'tshe ba/ brnyas shing dmod pa/ rku zhing 'phrog pa/ sdang zhing gdug pa'i bsam sbyor ngan pa byed pa'i mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad lo dang zla bar ma bzhag zhag dang za ma'i dus la rtags dang mtshan ma drag po bzod par dka' ba phob la/

sha rus lpags pa dum bur btubs/ 'khor 'bangs longs spyod phyogs bcur gtor/ snying khrag dron mo thang la phob/ gzugs phung sha khrag tshogs su rol/ rnam shes dag pa'i zhing du drongs shig gtad do gnyer ro bskul lo/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las da lta nyid du sgrub par mdzod cig ces brjod/ bzlas pa bya bar 'dod pas mgon po'i thugs kar srog gi ngo bo hūm̐ mthing nag gi mtha' skor du bzlas bya'i sngags 'phreng mthing ga me stag 'phro bas g.yas skor du bskor bar bsam/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa rtse mo lcags kyu'i rnam pa can 'phros/ mgon po'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig 'od zer gyi lcags kyus rtser gyis btab cing bzung bas/ mgon po'i thugs rang dbang med par rang gis dbang du bsdus/ sku 'dar zhing g.yo bas bka' nyan/ gsung bstod cing bcol ba'i las thams cad myur du sgrub par bsam/ lha mo dang mon pa la'ang gong ltar bsams la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la tri yaṃ dzaḥdzaḥ dgra bo mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces mgon po dang / trag rak+sha ha la dgra bo mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥ ces lha mo dang / dun ru tra ru thum bha ti dzaḥ shu la ra tsa tri sham dzaḥ yaṃ dzaḥ badz+ra trisna sa dhu kha thum tri sa ma ya dzaḥdagra bo mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces mon pa'i sngags rnams brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzlas/ thun mtshams rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyu de nyid me'i rang bzhin dmar nag tsha zhing rtsub pa 'phros nas mgon po la phog pas khro 'khrugs rngams pas 'khor rnams bskul/ khyad par srog bdud mon pa rnams las sprul pa'i pho nya mtshon cha dpag med 'phros/ dgra bgegs thams cad skad cig nyid la bsgral zhing za bar bsam la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la tri yaṃ dzaḥdzaḥ dgra bo mā ra ya nan/ mā ra ya gsod/ nag po dgra bo'i sha rgyus snying 'di thon thon/ bdud po dgra bo'i srog rtsa 'di chod chod/ nag po dgra bo'i bla rtsa la dzaḥdzaḥ

nag po dgra bo'i snying rtsa la dzaḥdzaḥ nag po dgra bo'i klad rtsa la dzaḥdzaḥ nag po dgra bo'i snying rgyus dbugs rtsa la dzaḥdzaḥ nag po dgra bo'i rtsa rgyus srog rtsa la dzaḥdzaḥ tsa tip+ta tsakra ni hūm̐/ ma tib bh+yo tsakra ni hūm̐/ baṃ ṇ+yi hūm̐ bh+yo/ ma ma ming dun bh+yo/ ma ma cho las la gram ha la ha la hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i gsang sngags nyer gcig la sogs pa drag tu bzlas so/ gong gi bsnyen sngags rnams thun bzhir ming tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod par 'bum phrag bcu la sogs pa bzlas pas/ dngos sam/ nyams rmi lam du mgon po 'khor bcas kyi sku mthong ba/ gsung thos pa/ slob dpon/ ban+dhe/ bon po/ a tsa ra/ mi nag po/ mon pa/ bya nag khyi nag g.yag nag 'od dang / rlung 'tshub/ sgra chen po/ sprin nag g.yo zhing 'brug sgra grags pa/ khang pa 'tshig pa/ sgo rdeb pa la sogs pa las sbyor gyi rtags/ sems can bsad pa/ ri dwags bshor ba/ cha rka len pa/ shing gcod pa/ mkhar bshig pa/ btson bzung ba/ dmag 'dren pa/ sgyogs 'cha' ba/ ser ba 'bebs pa/ bya gcan gyis lug dang byi'u gsod pa la sogs pa byung na gsad pa'i las 'grub/ rta dang shwa ba dang rkyang dang bong bu la sogs pa 'bros pa rmis na mi 'grub pa'i ltas yin pas ting nge 'dzin gsal bas nan tan bskyed/ sems rnam rtog rgya yan du 'gro ba dang / gnyid rmugs 'thibs pa dang / rtags ci yang med na dam tshig gso zhing bshags pa bya/ rnam 'joms dang mtshan brjod sher phyin 'don/ nag yor bas non cing / sngags btsun pa khyi nag dom nag sogs kyis 'ded cing / 'jigs skrag dang snying mi dga' ba byung na/ yi dam gyi ting nge 'dzin nga rgyal gsal btab/ grub pa'i rtags byung na gtang rag bya zhing 'phrin las 'chol lo/ /de nas bstod pa ni/ mi rkang dang thod rnga la sogs pa'i rol mo sgrog dbyangs dang bcas pas/ dngos grub brtan gzigs kyi le'u drug pa las 'byung / /hūm̐ bde chen 'du 'bral med pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/

/yang dag rngams pa'i sku gcig byung ba ni/ /mthing nag mi bsrun 'jigs byed 'bar ba'i sku/ /nyid kyi sku mdog mthing nag chen po la/ /dbu skra kham nag ral pa gyen du brdzes/ /smin ma nag po khro gnyer brjid pa'i zhal/ /spyan bzlog zhal bgrad mche ba rno gtsigs nas/ /sdang ba'i dgra bgegs ma lus snying rtsa chod/ /shangs nas me dang dug gi 'tshub ma gtong / /phyag gnyis thabs dang shes rab zung du 'brel/ /g.yas kyi phyag na tsan dan beng chen bsnams/ /gsor zhing gsor zhing klad pa'i rgyas su brdeg /g.yon gyi phyag na par bu dku la bsnams/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs ma lus snying khrag gsol/ /sku la mthing nag dar gyi ber chen gsol/ /gser ka rin chen 'phreng ba sked la bcings/ /zhabs la sag l+h+wam za 'og 'bol can gsol/ /ma hā kā la'i tshogs ni sprin ltar bstibs/ /dam nyams dgra bo ma lus rtsad nas gcod/ /thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /dpal ldan ma hā kā la ni/ /chibs su dpa' bo stag la chibs/ /seng ge gdug pa rol du khrid/ /res la seng la chibs nas kyang / /dpa' bo stag chen rol du khrid/ /mon pa nag po bdun dang bcas/ /sku yi sprul pa las kyi bdag /tri shu la yi rtse mo la/ /mi ro dmar po'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar/ /gsung gi sprul pa dmar nag ste/ /ma he'i rwa dung sgrogs pa yis/ /snang srid lha 'dre dam la sdud/ /thugs kyi sprul pa nag po ni/ /lcags kyi mon pa spu gri thogs/ /las mkhan be con thogs pa bzhi/ /dom dred bya khra rol zhing 'brang / /lha mo nag mo dmar nag bcas/ /drel rta zhon nas dmag dpung 'gyed/ /gtor ma gsol la phrin las mdzod/ /ces brjod/ las la bskul zhing gtor ma btab pa ni/ gtor ma la dpal 'bar btsugs/ khrag chang bran zhing / gtor ma dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag tu gsol ba/ mgon po 'khor bcas kyis hab thob tu bzhes nas drag po'i 'phrin las mdzad par bsam/

hūm̐ che btsan dpe med mgon nag ni/ /sku mdog nag po mun pa'i mdangs/ /sku la dar nag 'jol ber gsol/ /dbu la sbrul gyi ral pa can/ /mi yi thod pas dbu la brgyan/ /gdangs mig dmar la mche ba gtsigs/ /stag gi sma ra me ltar 'bar/ /snyan cha mgur chu mi thod dmar/ /gser skegs rin chen sku yi brgyan/ /zhabs la sag ti'i l+h+wam chen gsol/ /chibs su dpa' bo stag la chibs/ /rol du seng ge dkar mo khrid/ /phyag na tsan dan beng chen bsnams/ /gsor zhing klad pa'i rgyas su rdeg /gsod cig rgyobs shig khong snying phyungs/ /lha chen mgon po nag po khyod/ /nga la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di/ /myur du bzung la rnam par rgyobs/ /smyo ru chug la 'bog tu chug /lha chen mgon po nag po dang / /lha mo nag mo gnyis su med/ /lha mo nag mo chen mo ni/ /sku mdog dmar nag ral pa can/ /g.yas na bdud kyi khram shing bsnams/ /g.yon pa nad kyi rkyal pa thogs/ /chibs su dre'u rta rkang gsum chibs/ /sra ba dgu yi lte len bkal/ /khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /bka' nyan mon pa nag po gsum/ /sku yi sprul pa'i las mkhan ni/ /mon pa nag po gtum bag can/ /sku mdog nag po 'jigs pa la/ /zhal gdangs mche ba rab tu gtsigs/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa ste/ /g.yas pa kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum la/ /mi ro dmar po'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar/ /dar nag ru mtshon chen po yis/ /snang srid lha 'dre'i dmag dpung bsdud/ /bdud kyi zhags pa nag po yis/ /nyams pa'i mgul nas 'khrid par byed/ /ce spyang nag mos khrag rjes gcod/ /lcags kyi bya khras rgyu ma 'dren/ /bla 'gugs mon pa'i dus la babs/ /mon pa nag po las la bh+yo/ /gsung gi sprul pa'i las mkhan ni/ /las kyi mon nag 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /sku mdog dmar nag chen po la/ /khrag gi ral pa gyen du brdzes/ /g.yas pa ma he'i rwa dung 'bud/ /lha srin sde brgyad dmag dpung bsdud/

/g.yon pa lcags kyi phur bu yis/ /nyams pa'i snying la 'debs par byed/ /srog gcod mon pa'i dus la bab/ /gtum chen nag po las la bh+yo/ /thugs kyi sprul pa'i las mkhan ni/ /lcags kyi mon pa gsod byed de/ /sku mdog sngo nag rngams pa'i zhal/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa ste/ /g.yas pa srog gcod spu gri yis/ /nyams pa'i tsit+ta dmar 'don byed/ /g.yon pa lcags kyi sder mo yis/ /srog rtsa dmar po bton nas gsol/ /zhal bgrad ral pa gyen du brdzes/ /gcer bu nag po bdud kyi gzugs/ /gsod byed nag po las la bh+yo/ /dgra bo thal ba rdul du rlog /bdud kyi mon pa nag po bdun/ /bdud dmag 'bum gyi sna drangs te/ /nyams pa'i dgra yul dmag gis 'geng / /las kyi mon mo nag mo bdun/ /lag na khrag gi bh+yo zor 'phen/ /ma mo'i dal yams dgra la phob/ /lho phyogs gshin rje chen po brgyad/ /khyod kyi 'khor dang g.yog yin pas/ /gcan gzan mang po pho nyar 'gyed/ /byang phyogs gnod sbyin chen po brgyad/ /lcags kyi bya khra 'jigs par sprul/ /nyams pa'i dgra bo sha rus phrol/ /dur khrod gnas kyi ma mo rnams/ /bh+yo dang dza yi sgra sgrog cing / /nyams pa'i dgra la zon thun 'bebs/ /rnal 'byor yongs kyi dpal mgon po/ /lha chen mgon po nag po ste/ /ma hā kā la drag shul can/ /bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo 'di/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi sku dgra yin/ /rnal 'byor yongs kyi spyi dgra yin/ /sngags 'chang bdag la snyad btsugs so/ /srung ma khyod la phod btsugs so/ /ma btang myur du rnam par sgrol/ /smyo 'bog khrag skyugs gzer dang 'thibs/ /rims dal thang dmar brdal du chug /bdud kyi skya dmag mang po yis/ /nyams pa'i dgra bo'i sgo gnon zhig /dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor las bcol 'grub par mdzod/ /sdongs zla dregs pa bskul ba ni/ /hūm̐ bdud yul kha rag mgo dgu nas/

/bdud rgyal ri nag spungs pa khyod/ /nag po 'jigs tshul ral pas bstibs/ /sku la mi lpags rlon pa gsol/ /phyag na khram shing zhags pa thogs/ /bdud mkhar nang nas 'dir shog la/ /dgra la 'thibs nad drag po thongs/ /rgya yul nam mkha' chad chod nas/ /rgyal po 'od lha dkar po khyod/ /sku mdog dkar po brjid pa la/ /sku la dar dkar ras kha gsol/ /phyag na 'khor lo ral gri bsnams/ /shel mkhar nang nas 'dir shog la/ /dgra la smyo 'bog thongs la sgrol/ /me rlung bu yug 'tshub ma nas/ /ging chen lcags zhu nag po khyod/ /sku mdog nag po 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /khrag gi ral pa thur du bstibs/ /tri shu la dang thod khrag thogs/ /me rlung nang nas 'dir shog la/ /dgra la glo bur ye 'brog thongs/ /btsan yul zangs thang dmar po nas/ /btsan rje shu bo lag ring khyod/ /sku mdog dmar zhing rngams pa la/ /dar dmar thod bcings bse khrab gyon/ /zhags pas 'debs shing dar mdung 'dril/ /dgu brtsegs nang nas 'dir shog la/ /dgra la gri thabs yams su thongs/ /shar lho rin chen thang dkyil nas/ /ging chen rdo rje legs pa khyod/ /sku mdog ljang ser 'bar ba la/ /sku la za 'og slog pa gsol/ /dbu la stag thod khra bo bcings/ /phyag na rdo rje tsit+ta bsnams/ /lung thang mkhar nas 'dir shog la/ /dgra la pho log gzer thabs thongs/ /klu yul na ra si sngon nas/ /klu gnyan nag po srog gcod khyod/ /ljang nag sbrul gyi thod gdengs can/ /gcer bu g.yas na sbrul zhags bsnams/ /rin chen mkhar nas 'dir shog la/ /dgra la mdze shu phol 'bras thongs/ /mang yul byang shar mtsho nang nas/ /ma mo rdo rje sder chen khyod/ /nag po 'jigs byed khro mo'i sku/ /ral pa dmar nag gting za sad/ /sku stod zhing lpags g.yang gzhi ma/ /sku smad re lde stag lpags gsol/ /tri shu ban dmar phyag na bsnams/ /mthing nag gur nas 'dir shog la/ /dgra la rims dang glang thabs thongs/

/stong khams phyogs mtshams steng 'og nas/ /sprin dang me long 'tshub ma'i klong / /gza' bdud nag po rā hu la/ /dud kha mgo dgu sbrul mjug can/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan mda' gzhu thogs/ /sring mo gdong mo bzhi dang bcas/ /phyogs mtshams kun nas 'dir shog la/ /dgra la gdong gzer drag po thongs/ /zhes drag tu bskul zhing / spyir btab pa ni/ pha bla mas/ ༈ hūm̐ bh+yo/ rab 'jigs lcang lo can gyi dur khrod nas/ /drag shul mthu ldan bstan srung kun gyi gtso/ /stag zhon nag po bka' yi bya ra ba/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma mo yongs kyi gtso/ /lcam dral bka' nyan mon pa rnam gsum dang / /dregs pa sde brgyad srog sdud mon nag bdun/ /mon mo bdun dang lha srin bdud dmag tshogs/ /lho phyogs gshin rje byang phyogs gnod sbyin rnams/ /'dir byon dam rdzas dmar chen gtor ma bzhes/ /sman raka bdud rtsi phud kyi btung ba bzhes/ /dam nyams bsgral ba'i sha rus phung po bzhes/ /snying khrag 'khol ma'i khrag dron skom du bzhes/ /sngon tshe gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa nas/ /da lta rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag gi /bar du khyod nyid bka' dang dam la btags/ /bsten cing sgrub pa'i dam tshig gnyan po dgongs/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen khyod kyi srungs/ /dkon mchog dbu 'phang gnyan po khyod kyis bstod/ /rnal 'byor mgon skyabs dpung gnyen khyod kyis mdzod/ /mi nor dgon gnas srung ma khyed kyis mdzod/ /phas kyi byad kha rbod gtong drag po dang / /nad dang rims dang ltas ngan mtshan ma ngan/ /lo zla zhag dang za ma'i skeg la sogs/ /mi mthun phyogs kun dgra bo'i steng du bsgyur/ /bstan pa bshig dang rnal 'byor bdag cag la/ /gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs/ /yun ring lo dang zla bar ma bzhag par/ /zhag dang za mar ma thogs myur du sgrol/ /ma g.yel dgongs shig dpal mgon nag po che/ /stobs chen khyod kyi 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi/

/rnal 'byor bdag gi 'dod don kun bsgrubs nas/ /bstan pa dri med phyogs mthar rgyas par mdzod/ /ces pas gtor ma khang steng du 'bul ba'am/ dgra phyogs su 'phen pa sogs skabs su gang bab bya/ yig brgya tshar gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang / mgon po 'khor bcas lus dang grib ma ltar 'bral med du 'grogs par bsam la/ ༈ ho tshe rabs kun tu las smon mthun bsdebs pa'i/ /dpal mgon khyod kyi lus dang grib ma bzhin/ /nam yang 'bral ba med par 'grogs gyur nas/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun stsol shog /pha bla mas/ skye dang skye bar khyod sku sgom pa dang / /drag sngags bzla zhing khyod thugs bde chen dbyings/ /mnyam par bzhag pas nag po chen po nyid/ /gegs med bde blag nyid du 'grub par shog /'jigs rung khyod sku mig gis mngon sum mthong / /ha ha'i gad rgyangs 'brug stong ldir sgra sgrogs/ /khyod thugs myur ba nyid du bskul ba'i mthus/ /rgyal ba'i sras po srung ba'i mthu ldan shog /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas rnams/ /'di dang phyi ma dus rnams thams cad du/ /mgon po khyod kyis thugs rjes nyer bzung nas/ /bsams pa'i don rnams thams cad 'grub par shog /ces smon lam btab/ pha bla mas/ gzi brjid mun ltar 'thibs pa srin po'i sku/ /ha ha'i gad rgyangs sgrog pa drag po'i gsung / /bde stong dbyer med 'od gsal chen po'i thugs/ /bstan srung stag zhon nag po'i bkra shis shog /gnyis med sbyor ba'i yum chen re ma ti/ /bka' nyan las sgrub mon pa pho mo'i tshogs/ /stong khams khyab pa'i dregs pa sde brgyad sogs/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi bkra shis shog /pha rgod bla mas mngon sum zhal gzigs nas/ /pha rol dgra bo ma lus tshar bcad pa'i/ /pha mes brgyud pa'i srung ma gnyan po des/ /pha yis bu bzhin skyong ba'i bkra shis shog /ces sogs shis pa brjod cing me tog gi char bab bo/

/tshul 'di lta bus dus rtag tu bsten cing mchod na mgon po 'khor bcas rab tu mnyes nas/ rnal 'byor pa'i lus dang grib ma ltar 'grogs nas las thams cad thogs med du 'grub par 'gyur bas 'bad rtsol du bya bar 'os pa nyid do/ /zhes bstan srung nag po chen po stag zhon 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i cho ga mdor bsdus shing cha tshang bar bkod pa 'di ni gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyis shangs mda' myug gi rdo rje sgrom bur gter du sbas pa nor srung ltar bsgrub pa du ge ma'i skor dang / gtsang gi phung po ri bo cher sbas pa bka' bstod ltar sgrub pa tri yaṃ ma'i bskor dang / rong g.yung gi rdza lhu mor sbas pa drag sngags su sgrub pa dug gi spu gri'i skor te/ gter kha rim pa gsum du sbas pa/ grang nga kun grags kyis gter nas spyan drangs te bsgyur ba las/ tri yaṃ ma gtso bor byas gzhan rnams kyi'ang skabs su bab pas kha bskang / gnubs pa ba dang / rong pa dang / lce ston dang / phyal pa'i bla ma brgyud pa dag las 'ongs pa'i gsung sgros dang / mthong ba brgyud pa'i man ngag gis rnam par brgyan nas 'di nyid bsten par 'dod pa'i sngags 'chang las dang po pa rnams la phan pa'i bsam pas kun nas bslangs te/ ldong gi ban+dhe sngags 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos 'dar stod gangs can gyi ri bo'i chos grwar legs par sbyar ba'o/ /'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/ //shubhamastusarbadzagataṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 20 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ mgon po stag zhon snubs lugs kyi gtor chog 'phrin las lhun grub/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 19
